response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(replacement_cost) AS avg_rc, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS avg_daily FROM film GROUP BY rating), g AS (SELECT r.*, AVG(avg_daily) OVER () AS overall_daily FROM r) SELECT AVG(avg_rc) AS avg_replacement_cost, AVG(avg_daily) AS avg_daily_price, AVG(avg_daily - overall_daily) AS avg_excess FROM g WHERE avg_daily > overall_daily;

assumptions.assumption: The cross-rating average is the unweighted mean of the 5 ratings' average daily prices, taken over all ratings before filtering. Ratings with a daily price strictly above it are kept.
The final averages are simple (unweighted) means over the kept ratings, not weighted by film count.
Every film has a non-null rental_rate and a nonzero rental_duration. The verified data shows durations of 3 to 7 days, so no film is excluded.
